context_requirements: Expression of P2RY1 or P2RY12 receptors
Functional Gq/Gi signaling downstream of purinergic receptors
Presence of extracellular nucleotides or receptor tone to antagonize
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known P2RY1/P2RY12 antagonism
Changes in immediate-early genes or calcium-regulated genes consistent with purinergic receptor blockade
